Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 2) shows a pulmonary nodule in the right lower lung field (indicated by the arrow) and a soft tissue density in the right breast region; anatomically, the lung tumor is positioned medially relative to the lateral breast mass. Given the clinical history of an unusual metastatic pattern in a male, this presentation is consistent with metastatic spread from a primary lung carcinoma to the breast.
